Headline: News - Multi-Academy Trusts (National)
Info: Ofsted has announced that the rollout of new inspections for multi-academy trusts is unlikely to begin until 2028, pending the completion of new trust standards by the Department for Education.

Headline: Merger - Roundabout Nursery (State), Brighton
Info: Roundabout Nursery in Whitehawk has officially joined the Aurora Academies Trust, transferring from the control of Brighton & Hove City Council.

Headline: Financial - UK State Schools (National)
Info: A survey by the National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) reveals that around a third of school leaders are considering restructures or redundancies due to severe funding shortages and falling pupil rolls.

Headline: Financial - Monkseaton High School (State), North Tyneside
Info: Following its closure in August, it has been revealed that Monkseaton High School's £8.57m deficit accounts for nearly 60% of North Tyneside Council's projected collective school debt, highlighting severe regional financial pressures.

Headline: Closure - St David's Catholic Primary School (State), Flintshire
Info: Local councillors have called in a cabinet decision regarding a proposed school closure and super-school consultation in Mold, citing concerns over an undisclosed potential land-swap deal involving the St David's site.

Headline: Closure - King Solomon High School (State), London
Info: King Solomon High School is currently consulting on a potential closure at the end of the academic year due to falling pupil numbers, prompting some students to transfer early to Yavneh College.
